# FairRound

> The on-chain IPO exchange for crypto projects, on Arbitrum One. A project lists through a fair sale that runs in hourly rounds; everyone filled in a round pays the same clearing price, at most 150 units sell per round, and oversubscribed rounds fill every bid pro rata. 99% of what buyers pay goes into a project treasury that holders control: every payment is a holder vote with a 5-day delay and a per-term cap, and holders can remove the project lead. Live as a demo: bids use UNRIG, a free test credit with no value; the demo listings are fictional.

The site is available in English and Georgian (ქართული). Pages are rendered in the browser and read live data from the contracts.

## Pages

- [Listings](https://www.fairround.xyz/): all listed demo projects, their round stage, units sold and the raise
- [Become an investor](https://www.fairround.xyz/invest): verify a wallet (it must hold at least 0.0083 ETH on Arbitrum One; nothing is taken) and claim 1,000 UNRIG test credits, once per wallet
- [Rules](https://www.fairround.xyz/rules): the rules the contracts enforce, in plain words
- [White paper](https://www.fairround.xyz/whitepaper): how FairRound works and what isn't solved yet
- [Market](https://www.fairround.xyz/market): units listed for sale by their holders
- [Portfolio](https://www.fairround.xyz/portfolio): look up the units, bids, votes and roles of any address

## Key rules

- Rounds: up to 150 units a round, one-hour rounds with a one-hour pause between them. Everyone in a round pays the same clearing price. 99% of what is paid goes to the project treasury, 1% to FairRound. Units lock for 7 days.
- Project lead: elections open at 50% of units sold. A lead wins with yes votes from 20% of the electorate and 51% of votes cast, serves 30 days, and holders can vote to remove them.
- Treasury: every payment, sale or investment is a holder proposal with a 5-day delay before it runs. At most 5% of a bucket can be spent per term.
- New investors: at most 50 an hour.
- Admin: every owner change goes through a public 48-hour timelock.

## Contracts (Arbitrum One, verified on Arbiscan)

The contract names are from the project's first version, Sakartvelo Exchange.

- InvestToken (UNRIG): 0xbc780aeB45FdDA0258aB163a99fE92f97209E2c0
- RoundAuctionV9: 0xb08631827d87C69Ff44d692EEFF32E1b22E4c503
- GovernanceV9: 0x2fd99a2328866E458Cbc38266c9ff49319A7613b
- CompanyTreasuryV9: 0xD2107dEE7EA2E8038F7778f63Cf6Eee659dB1F29
- CompanyDividendsV9: 0x91B05614ae7c6cA516820317aDf3D03cCa056C73
- OpenVerifierV2: 0x0d07CB79b17229d6301E96dBfEDf09e76c9d68C7
- FairRoundTimelock (owner, 48-hour delay): 0x15FC689FD5ba86D3FC052E6E1E7b48623c17732A
- VotedUnrig (vUNRIG): 0xe945B87f8B506B05Eb50c5d19ffe954398E49684. A freely transferable demo token created only by burning UNRIG that a holder vote paid out of a treasury of a listing with at least 9 units. One-way: not backed, not redeemable, not an investment, no promise of price. Free claims, refunds and dividends can never be converted. Public test from 31 October 2026.
